modules.module_title: Handle hand/power tools for electrical works.

pcs.pc_description: perform basic checks on power tools prior to use
handle hand/power tools for establishing/ terminating electrical connections as per requirement
use appropriate tools to trace out short circuits/faults and leakages in electrical wiring
use measuring instruments to measure size and dimension of wires, conduits as per electrical installation or maintenance work requirement
use hand/ power tools to cut, and bend wire and conduit as per electrical installation or maintenance work requirement
use appropriate tools to splice wires by stripping insulation from terminal leads and twisting wires together
use appropriate hand/power tools to thread conduit ends, connect couplings, and fabricate and secure conduit support brackets
use appropriate electrical measuring devices like ammmeter, voltmeter,meggers etc.to examine electrical units for power interruptions/ continuity
use electrical devices such as starters, circuit breakers, relays as per equipment/ wiring installation rating or current rating
use diagnostic devices like multi-meter, tong tester, earth tester or similar devices to install, repair power connections
perform maintenance and upkeep of relevant tools and devices after use

modules.module_title: Installation of temporary lighting arrangement at construction sites

pcs.pc_description: check cable, conduits , lights, sockets, temporary power distribution panels at power source and other required fixtures and accessories as per manufacturers guidelines and specification
lay cables through ducts or conduits, underground or through poles (overhead) as per plans and instructions
select the type and wattage of lights considering illumination requirement at worksite and install them at secured positions

fix lights and its accessories, brackets, bulkheads with screws and bolts or by other standard means, pull wires through conduit leading to connection boxes, temporary panels/ distribution boards or other temporary electrical terminals
extend/ join LV electrical cable using straight through joints, splicing them together and secure joints by applying PVC insulation tapes, caps or by other safe method as and when necessary
carry out termination of LV cables selecting the right method as per standard practice
work safely as per electrical safety guidelines provided by manufacturer, standard safety practice or organizational safety norms while establishing or disconnecting live electrical connections
upkeep of all relevant key electrical tools and fixtures
tag embedded, exposed electrical lines and other key equipment appropriately
shift light at various locations during construction activity as per requirement
repair and replace light arrangements as per instruction or requirement
replace burned out bulbs, light units and ballast in light fixtures as needed
carry out relevant tests to trace out power interruptions/ continuity at lighting arrangements
replace damaged cable, other relevant parts as and when necessary
replace faulty circuit breakers, fuses, switches, electrical and electronic components and wire as per requirement
perform preventive maintenance on diesel generators at site provided for temporary lighting (if any) at scheduled intervals as per direction of concerned authority

modules.module_title: Assemble temporary LV power distribution panels (distribution boards)

pcs.pc_description: read relevant SLDs(Single Line Diagrams), instructions, safety guidelines, manufacturers specifications prior to assembling temporary panel/ distribution boards
install required fixtures like power sockets, switches, wires, MCBs(Miniature Circuit Breakers) of appropriate specification as per circuit load requirement
ensure tightness and safe working condition of wires, fixtures prior to the connection of the assembly with power source
connect DB (Distribution Board) to main power cable and perform standard tests to ensure its safe and desired working
place and secure the distribution board against external damaging agents like water, fire etc
carry out proper termination of cables as per standard practice while connecting to the sockets of the panel
carry out earthing of the panels as per standard procedure
check and ensure necessary tagging and barrication near the live/ active electrical distribution boards

modules.module_title: Repair/ replace faulty parts/ fixtures as per requirement

pcs.pc_description: carry out visual inspection of the live/ active board regularly to ensure safe working condition of all components
ensure that the live connections get discontinued after completion of daily construction works in order to minimize energy wastage and enhance working efficiency of electrical units
respond promptly to failure/ damage or malfunctioning of panel or any of its components
carry out necessary tests in order to determine root cause of failure
notify concerned authorities prior to shut down, deactivation or repair of the electrical unit
replace/ repair faulty components as per SLD, instructions, safety guidelines and manufacturers specifications
document and keep records relevant to maintenance/ repair of panels as per organizational norms
isolate the panel safely and shift to another location as per requirement
